title: MONTHLY ENTERPRISE CYBERSECURITY
THREAT INTELLIGENCE SUMMARY
report.sourceNote: Compiled automatically from CISA KEV, NVD, FIRST EPSS, Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD, VulnCheck, Metasploit, Exploit-DB, PoC-in-GitHub and MITRE ATT&CK. Counts are catalog counts, not a count of cyber incidents; anything the sources do not establish is stated as not established.

blocks.text: CISA added **43 vulnerabilities** to the KEV catalog in September 2026, spanning 25 vendors. The highest-likelihood additions by EPSS were **CVE-2026-75650 (Adobe Commerce and Magento)** and **CVE-2026-85706 (GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition)**. Outside KEV, 4 further CVEs were reported exploited or tracked as zero-days by Google Project Zero, ENISA EUVD or VulnCheck.
These are CISA KEV catalog counts, not a count of total cyber incidents.

**Top five actions:** (1) Isolate or patch exposed Adobe Commerce and Magento (CVE-2026-75650); (2) isolate or patch exposed GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition (CVE-2026-85706); (3) isolate or patch exposed WordPress Core (CVE-2026-87902); (4) isolate or patch exposed Adobe Commerce and Magento (CVE-2026-71362); (5) examine Adobe Commerce and Magento hosts for unexpected child processes and outbound connections.

blocks.text: **CVE-2026-75650 - Adobe Commerce and Magento template injection (CVSS 10).** Adobe Commerce is affected by an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation of this issue does not require user interaction. Scope is changed. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): commerce 2.4.4, commerce b2b 1.3.3, magento 2.4.6. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-85706 - GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition path traversal (CVSS 10).** GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.7 before 18.11.12, 19.0 before 19.0.9, 19.1 before 19.1.8, 19.2 before 19.2.6, and 19.3 before 19.3.2 that, under certain conditions, an unauthenticated user could have read arbitrary files from the GitLab server due to improper path confinement and missing authentication… Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): gitlab 18.11.12, gitlab 19.0.9, gitlab 19.1.8, gitlab 19.2.6. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-87902 - WordPress Core WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability (CVSS 8.1).** An unauthenticated attacker can make `get_page_template()` page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories. If relevant pre-conditions for both the server and the active theme are met, this can lead to RCE. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): wordpress 4.7.37, wordpress 4.8.32, wordpress 4.9.33, wordpress 5.0.29. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
KEV additions by week: week of Aug 31: 8; week of Sep 7: 14; week of Sep 14: 7; week of Sep 21: 12; week of Sep 28: 2.
No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds. Victim counts and campaign scope are not established unless cited in section 5.

**Defensive hunting focus:** unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes (13 CVEs); unusual requests and changes (10 CVEs); unexpected child processes and outbound connections (10 CVEs).
